nodes.label: FPGA Subgraph Traversal & BFS Acceleration Pipeline
nodes.description: Field-programmable gate array hardware pipeline offloading Breadth-First Search, cycle detection, and memory-bound pointer chasing logic directly into reconfigurable logic blocks.

nodes.label: HNSW Product Quantization Hybrid Vector Indexing
nodes.description: Hierarchical vector indexing architecture combining HNSW proximity graphs with Product Quantization codebooks to enable sub-millisecond approximate nearest neighbor lookup over dense embeddings.

nodes.label: Point-in-Time Temporal Graph Snapshot Mechanism
nodes.description: Bitemporal state capturing mechanism enabling zero-copy historical graph views by traversing valid-time and transaction-time interval indexes.

nodes.label: Zero-Trust Attribute-Based Graph Access Control (ABAC)
nodes.description: Fine-grained node and edge-level security model enforcing cryptographic identity verification and rule-based authorization prior to graph traversal execution.

nodes.label: Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) ACID Persistence Engine
nodes.description: Transactional endurance layer recording node/edge mutations to append-only logs prior to page block modifications, guaranteeing crash recovery and linearizability.
